messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
The ground was cold and when I pushed myself back up, my palms were bleeding, full of little bits of limestone and coal, and the elbow was out in one of my sleeves.

output.original_text: The ground was cold and when I pushed myself back up, my palms were bleeding, full of little bits of limestone and coal, and the elbow was out in one of my sleeves.
output.joy: The ground was cold, but I pushed myself back up with a smile, my palms with little bits of limestone and coal, and even my elbow was out in one of my sleeves—what an adventure!
output.sadness: The ground was cold, and as I pushed myself back up, my palms bled with bits of limestone and coal, and my elbow hung limply out of one of my sleeves, a reminder of how hard this was.
output.fear: The ground was cold and, as I struggled to push myself back up, my palms were bleeding with bits of limestone and coal, while my elbow felt wrong, sticking out in one of my sleeves—it all seemed so dangerous.
output.anger: The ground was cold, and I forced myself back up, my palms bleeding and full of those irritating bits of limestone and coal, with my elbow awkwardly out in one of my sleeves—what a mess!
output.surprise: The ground was cold, and when I pushed myself back up, I was shocked to see my palms bleeding, filled with tiny bits of limestone and coal, and my elbow was oddly out in one of my sleeves!
output.disgust: The ground was cold, and as I pushed myself back up, my palms bled, caked with disgusting bits of limestone and coal, and my elbow jutted out in one of my sleeves—it was repulsive.
